name: MFA
objective: Ensure multi-factor authentication is enforced for all interactive users.
risk: Account takeover through stolen or guessed credentials.
test_procedure: Compare the active user list against the MFA enrollment export; every active user must be enrolled.

name: Privileged Access
objective: Ensure privileged access is properly authorized.
test_procedure: Compare assigned administrative roles against approved access records.

name: Access Expiration
objective: Ensure temporary access is revoked on its approved expiry date.
risk: Stale access remains after business need ends.
test_procedure: Compare temporary access grants against their expiry dates in the access export.

name: Periodic User Access Review
objective: Ensure managers review and certify user access periodically.
test_procedure: Verify that every in-scope application has a completed, signed-off review for the period.

name: Change Approval
objective: Ensure production changes are approved before deployment.
risk: Unauthorized or untested changes cause outages.
test_procedure: Sample production changes and confirm an approval timestamp precedes deployment.

name: Emergency Change Review
objective: Ensure emergency changes are reviewed after implementation.
risk: Emergency path is used to bypass normal approval.
test_procedure: Confirm every emergency change has a post-implementation review within 5 business days.

name: Backup Job Monitoring
risk: Data loss due to unnoticed backup failures.
test_procedure: Review backup job logs for the period; failures must have a documented re-run.

name: Restore Testing
objective: Ensure backups can actually be restored.
risk: Backups exist but cannot be restored.
test_procedure: Inspect the latest restore test record: success status and recovery time within target.

name: Log Retention
objective: Ensure security logs are retained for the required period.
test_procedure: Compare configured retention per log source against the policy minimum.

name: Critical Patching
objective: Ensure critical patches are applied within the SLA.
test_procedure: Compare critical vulnerabilities against patch dates; flag items older than 14 days.
